research_intent: Explore a falsifiable new rule or relational structure while preserving exact source and experiment boundaries.
creative_invitations: Enumerate more than one possible future without presupposing which one wins
Let unjoined historical paths remain distinct
Distinguish mathematical invariance from interpretive response
Record every failed assay rather than laundering it into prose

proposals.label: An invented crossing with explicit possible refutation
proposals.hypothesis: Equal-cost routes can conceal source-warrant histories, even when their scalar minimum distance agrees.

geometry.counterexample: two paths with distinct consent and same scalar cost

nks.gluing: only admit equivalence when exact provenance maps are declared

proposals.prediction: Scalar-only output may hide a route difference that a complete-history comparator can recover.
proposals.consequence: Do not claim novelty unless a competent null with the same information is outperformed.

controls.falsifier: An information-matched comparator recovers all the same admissible route differences.
controls.competent_null: Independent full-history graph traversal with identical clocks, source access and actions.
controls.negative_control: Swap only non-informational ambiance with source and kernel fixed.

proposals.artistic_notes: Wild Field is permitted; a missing warrant is a space for inquiry, not a hidden fact.
